proposals.evidence: The first tucchya branch includes Prakrit chuccha, Bhojpuri chũch, Awadhi chũch/chūchā and Hindi chūchā empty. These Dang chucha/cuce forms fit that affricate series and final-vowel variation; the distinct northwestern tuśya branch is not used.
